digest.component_or_area: pytest nested test execution and temporary directory management
propositions: nested pytest child processes without explicit --basetemp join the user-global numbered root and delete cleanup-eligible sibling directories at session finish
tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py and tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py launch executing nested pytest children that allocate the shared numbered root without parent-owned basetemp isolation
parent process must pass a unique tmp_path-derived --basetemp to each nested child to prevent cross-session temp directory deletion
pytest 9.1.1 TempPathFactory.getbasetemp creates and registers cleanup for numbered roots; pytest_sessionfinish runs that cleanup unless _basetemp remains None
repair applies parent-owned basetemp to both executing nested launchers while preserving interpreter entrypoint, cwd, selectors, plugins, and assertions
held-out regression confirms the sentinel bytes remain unchanged after repair and are deleted before repair
